Class NonceClaimValidator

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.security.oauth2.endpoint.token.response.validation.NonceClaimValidator
@Requires(property="micronaut.security.token.jwt.claims-validators.nonce", notEquals="false") @Singleton public class NonceClaimValidator extends Object
Responsible for validating the nonce claim.

When a NonceFactory bean is present, every authorization request sent by this library carries a nonce parameter which is persisted (for example in a cookie) until the callback. In that case the persisted nonce must be present at callback time and must match the nonce claim of the ID token; a missing persisted nonce is treated as a validation failure, even if the ID token does not carry a nonce claim either.

This assumes that the authorization request carries the nonce built by the NonceFactory bean and that the nonce is persisted with the NoncePersistence bean. An application with a custom authorization request or redirect handler which omits the nonce, or with a custom NonceFactory which does not persist the nonce with NoncePersistence, must disable nonce support (micronaut.security.oauth2.openid.nonce.enabled: false); otherwise every login fails.

When no NonceFactory bean is present (for example, micronaut.security.oauth2.openid.nonce.enabled is false) the authorization request does not carry a nonce, so validation passes only when neither a persisted nonce nor a nonce claim exists.

Flows without an authorization request, such as the password grant, never send a nonce. They must use validateWithoutNonce(OpenIdClaims, OauthClientConfiguration, OpenIdProviderMetadata).

      @Deprecated(since="5.6.0", forRemoval=true) public NonceClaimValidator()
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Use NonceClaimValidator(NonceFactory) instead.
      Creates a validator which accepts a missing persisted nonce when the ID token has no nonce claim, the behavior before 5.6.0. A subclass which does not call NonceClaimValidator(NonceFactory) explicitly uses this constructor and does not get the stricter validation. The use of this constructor is logged at WARN.

    • validateWithoutNonce

      public boolean validateWithoutNonce(OpenIdClaims claims, OauthClientConfiguration clientConfiguration, OpenIdProviderMetadata providerMetadata)
      Validates the claims of an ID token obtained without an authorization request, for example with the password grant. No nonce is sent in such flows, so the ID token must not carry a nonce claim.

      This method does not call validate(OpenIdClaims, OauthClientConfiguration, OpenIdProviderMetadata, String). A subclass which overrides validate must also override this method to customize the validation of such flows.

      Parameters:
      claims - ID Token Claims
      clientConfiguration - OAuth 2.0 Client Configuration. Not used by this implementation; available to subclasses.
      providerMetadata - OpenID Connect provider metadata. Not used by this implementation; available to subclasses.
      Returns:
      Whether the JWT Claims pass validation or not.
      Since:
      5.6.0
